verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a first-party GitHub Actions CI/CD guide for running agent tests automatically on every code change, pull request, or schedule, and it also ships a CLI and SDK. That covers running evals in CI. The evidence never shows that failing results or rubric thresholds fail the build or block a deployment, so the gating half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented pass/fail exit codes or threshold-based build gating, an explicit deployment-blocking workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
